content:
Pat D: Quick check on alert preview ordering. noticed preview shows channels newest-first which clashes with how customers set priority. Sarah M: Yep saw that. users expect "priority" order (highest -> lowest) or explicit dispatch order. current UI is confusing. Mike L: A11y: screenreaders read DOM order. if visual != DOM we're creating mismatch. we should keep them identical. Elaine K: FYI backend returns dispatch sequence for sends (can include fallbacks). frontend had been sorting by modified_at for display. Pat D: Options: 1) show priority (user mental model) or 2) show runtime dispatch order but label it clearly. which minimizes surprises? Sarah M: If runtime order differs from priority we must surface why. add a short help text: "Order reflects runtime dispatch (see routing)". Mike L: For SR users, don't say "3 channels". say: "Alerts will be sent to PagerDuty, then Slack, then Email." put that in an aria-live region. Pat D: Draft copy: "This alert will notify: PagerDuty, then Slack, then Email." happy? Sarah M: Nice and explicit. avoid extra punctuation. commas + "then" reads well. Elaine K: Also suppression: preview currently omits suppressed channels. Ops wants them visible for confirmation. we can gray them out with a label "suppressed until ". Mike L: Gray + label works. ensure contrast and that the label is accessible. add aria-describedby to explain suppression state. Pat D: Keyboard flow: when tabbing into preview, focus should hit the announce text so SRs get immediate context. Sarah M: Also add a small tooltip link: "Why this order" pointing to routing docs. copy: "Order reflects runtime dispatch; suppressed channels shown as greyed." Elaine K: Short-term API tweak: we'll add a "render_order" array on routes so frontend can rely on it without reordering. will document rollback plan. ops-bot: FYI: this change will be behind console feature-flag. see https://go/redwood/design/preview-order for rollout notes. Mike L: Reusable aria snippet: ```
This alert will notify: PagerDuty, then Slack, then Email.
``` Pat D: Great. i'll make a tiny mock with muted suppressed rows and the priority pill (visually: #1, with sr-only "priority one"). tagging Sarah for copy review when ready. :thumbsup: Sarah M: sounds good. thanks team. Mike L: one last nit: ensure the suppressed timestamp uses relative phrasing for SRs like "suppressed for 2h 15m" instead of raw iso. easier to parse. Elaine K: noted. will include both fields in API: suppressed_until_iso and suppressed_until_relative. Pat D: perfect. i'll drop the mock in this thread later today.
